tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Search open akay.ie trade offers by keyword, EAN, size ("70cl", "6x70cl"), ABV or duty status, with optional website filters. Returns listed sell prices per case and per unit in each offer's own currency (EUR, USD or GBP), pack, duty status, Incoterm, location and stock. Paged: up to 25 per page, 10

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Full public details of one open offer by its akay.ie offer_id (or akay.ie offer URL), with the akay.ie link and how to order.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Price one product (offer_id, EAN or name) for a quantity in cases. Returns the listed price per case and per unit in the offer's currency, the line total worked out in code, and MOQ and stock checks. If several offers fit, returns candidates instead of picking one. Optional target price comparison.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Categories with offer counts and top brands, plus the values available for the duty status, Incoterm, stock and location filters.

tools.name: price_my_list
tools.description: Price a buying list (up to 100 lines / 20 KB): product names or EANs, quantities in cases and optional target prices. tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Turn confirmed lines (offer_id + cases, or units for offers priced per unit) into a quote request summary and a CSV the buyer uploads at quote.akay.ie/#excel, plus WhatsApp and email options. tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the akay.ie trade catalogue. Returns offer ids, titles and akay.ie URLs. Use fetch with an id for full details.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full public details of one akay.ie offer by the id returned from search.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_offer, search · Private data: request_quote · Public sink: request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_offer, search · Private data: request_quote · Public sink: request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
